page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a running head above and a signature mark below. No margin notes.

main_text.p: est medium urbis punctum, ubi plærunq; forum esse solet. Forum est frumentarium piscarium, suarium, boarium, vinarium, olitorium, scrutarium, lignarium.
Radii a centro exeuntes sunt plateæ & viæ stratæ.

In urbibus præterea consideranda sunt, Curia, ærarium, Schatzkammer, armamentarium, harnisch kammer/cella vinaria, cerevisiaria, pharmacopolia, theatrum, porticus, basilica, Xenodochiū, ein gasthauß/ nosodochium, ein Frankenhauß / thermæ, balneæ, templa cum cœmiteriis & epitaphiis, cœnobia, collegia cum Bibliothecis, & parœciæ, Die Gei[?] samlung Derer so in eine Kirche gehö:en.
main_text.head: Quot sunt in Politia consideranda?
main_text.p: Species politiæ: utrum Monarchia sit, an Aristocra-tia, an Timocratia. Item leges, judicia, genera num-morum argenteorum & aureorum.
main_text.head: Quænam in incolis sunt considerandæ?
main_text.p: An cives sint an advenæ: qui eorum mores, qui ri-tus, qui habitus, quæ ratio victus: quinam sint insi-gnes divitiis, nobilitate, artibus vel bellicis, vel Me-chanicis. An sint multi Theologi, Philosophi, Juris-consulti, Medici.
Lecturus præcepta prolixiora, videat Zvingerum, Hilarium, Pirckmajerum vel alios.
Hactenus fuit Apodemica exposita: sequitur de Polemica.

page.notes: The black-letter words (Schatzkammer, harnisch, kammer, gasthauß, Frankenhauß, gehö:en) are German in fraktur; the spelling is as printed. The phrase "Die Gei[?] samlung" is doubtful: the word after "Die" is not clearly legible, so I have marked it [?]. The first word of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The "D" at the foot is a gathering signature.
